edits.rationale: wet gate on friction_est via h1 unit 0, dead on nominal
h2 unit 0 lowers alpha_v when wet

hypothesis: A friction_est-gated alpha_v reduction on wet states (h1 unit 0, dead on nominal, driving dead h2 unit 0 and suppressing alpha_v-raising h2 units) lowers speed in wet curves. Nominal states are essentially untouched (offline nominal shift about 0.015 mean).
expected_effect: Wet-curve alpha_v drops by about 0.65 with near-zero nominal shift. Rollouts on seeds 50005-50007 gave max lat accel ratio 0.57, 1.33 and 0.56, so 2 of 3 passed. Earlier seeds 50000-50004 improved only partly. Expect partial OOD success with nominal driving retained.
